main_text.head: IN PSALMVM LXXIII. τὰ[?] προλεγόμενα.
ΠΡΟΛΕΓΟΜΕΝΑ.
main_text.p: QUUM Deo benedicēte nostris studiis & laboribus, jam absol-uerimus enarrationem ObadiaLectio 1.[?] prophetā, quàm ideò instituera-4. Maij. mus, vt quomodo nos consolari & erigere debeamus, si quando falsi fratres nos oppugnant, sumemus in manus Psalmū 73, vt ex eo discamus illam praclarā doctrinam, quae medetur cordis ægritudini, quam parit diuturna improborum prosperitas, & piorum calamitas.1584.
Docendi autem gratia de principiis istius Psalmi, & argumenti, quod ille continet, ordine agemus.

1. Efficiēs causa. Inscriptio, Psalmus Asaphi, monet huic eximio Prophetæ, diuinitus dictatam esse hanc sacram Odam. Non enim hominum voluntate allata est olim prophetia, sed acti à spiritu sancto loquuti sunt (idē autem & de Scriptis eorum iudicium est) sancti Dei homines. 2. Pet. 1. 21.
De laudibus Asaphi, qui Dauidi ceu col

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the large initial is read as a decorated Q, giving QUUM (for quum); the scan could also show a C. The Greek subtitle reads as τὰ προλεγόμενα, the first letter is uncertain. "Lectio 1." is uncertain, the numeral may be "t." or "1." The word "Obadia" is printed with a space before the "a", and the final letter may be æ. The mark over "Asaphi" in the heading line is a printer's sign and is not transcribed. The page number 133 is printed at the head. The catchword "lega" and signature "I 3" are at the foot.
